description: Source code for the 'Frame' class in Playwright, managing browser frame interactions including navigation, element handling, and event management.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a browser frame, providing methods for navigation, element interaction, and event handling within the frame.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the Page object associated with this frame.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates the frame to a specified URL.

methods.name: waitForNavigation
methods.description: Waits for the frame to navigate to a new URL based on specified options.

methods.name: waitForLoadState
methods.description: Waits for the frame to reach a specified load state.

methods.name: waitForURL
methods.description: Waits until the frame's URL matches a given pattern.

methods.name: frameElement
methods.description: Returns the element handle for the frame element.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the frame context and returns a handle.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the frame context and returns the result.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a FrameLocator for nested frame interactions.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with a specific test ID.

methods.name: getByAltText
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific alt text.

methods.name: getByLabel
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific label text.

methods.name: getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific placeholder text.

methods.name: getByText
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific text content.

methods.name: getByTitle
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific title text.

methods.name: getByRole
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with a specific role.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks on an element matching the selector.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an input element with specified text.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers over an element matching the selector.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a dropdown element.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for an input element.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into an element.

methods.name: waitForTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a specified timeout.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the title of the frame.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Returns the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: parentFrame
methods.description: Returns the parent frame, if any.

methods.name: childFrames
methods.description: Returns an array of child frames.

methods.name: isDetached
methods.description: Checks if the frame is detached.
